assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original isolated CLOUD CANOPY AND FLOATING BED ASSEMBLY for a portfolio website animation, inspired by the user's latest reference photograph. Transparent background, no landscape, no sky, no ground, no cast ground shadow. A small unoccupied bed suspended beneath ONE large fluffy white cumulus cloud canopy by four very thin pale vertical cords. The cloud is soft natural cotton with rounded voluminous lobes, realistic gentle shading, dreamy airy photographic surrealism, not a cartoon, not a vector illustration. The bed has a simple pale sky-blue low platform, soft plump blue-white pillows, a loosely rumpled pale icy-blue duvet draping gracefully over the right edge, seen in a gentle three-quarter view like the reference. Canopy width slightly wider than the bed. Cloud in the top quarter of the square canvas; bed in lower quarter; a clearly visible open gap between them with fine suspension cords. Cohesive soft sunlight from upper left, clean exquisite small details on bed fabric, gentle cloud edge transparency, no hard black outlines, no faces, no people, no lettering, no extra objects. Full assembly centered, no cropping of cloud or bed. Large empty transparent margins of about 8 percent. Keep the topmost 8 percent and all sides transparent. High quality square composition suitable for a 320px wide animated hero centerpiece.
assets.reference: User-supplied cloud canopy and suspended bed on a grassy hill photograph

assets.prompt: Edit target: the generated cloud-and-bed assembly. Keep ONLY its upper fluffy white cumulus cloud, matching the original soft photographed texture, rounded lobes and lighting exactly. Remove the bed, every suspension cord, and every stray detached pixel or wisp below the cloud. Transparent background. The complete isolated cloud should span about 86 percent of a wide 2:1 canvas, centered vertically, with a clean naturally soft transparent edge and generous 7 percent transparent margin on every side. No rain, no stars, no strings, no bed, no ground, no sky, no additional objects. This cloud will be used in the distant sky alongside the original canopy so their style must match.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. An original seamless square texture of lush soft green meadow grass for a dreamy surreal photographic scene, viewed straight down from several meters above the ground. Fine short closely mown grass blends into broad velvety softly shaded sage, lime and fresh green areas. Natural subtle density variation, silky smooth and calm rather than sharp, spiky or busy. Diffuse daylight evenly across the entire image, no directional shadows or vignetting. Uniform scale and uniform green brightness, no soil, no flowers, no large leaves, no objects, no paths, no horizon, no sky, no lettering. Must tile unobtrusively on all four edges. Visually resembles the soft grassy hillside in a peaceful surreal cloud-bed photograph. High-resolution premium photographic texture, no artificial pattern, no plastic spikes.

notes: Generated originals packaged with Sharp; transparent alpha preserved.

Scene camera remains fixed. The cloud-bed assembly gently sways in its measured layout stage below the hero actions. A single perspective meadow texture and distant cloud layers supply background movement.
Original six browser-local time phases, deterministic aesthetic weather, night-sky movie and still fallback are retained.
